protocol_metadata.about: Lombard Finance is a Bitcoin finance protocol that lets users deposit native BTC to mint LBTC, a 1:1 backed liquid Bitcoin ERC-20 token, or deposit LBTC into the LBTCv DeFi Vault to earn automated yield across protocols such as Uniswap, Pendle, Morpho, and Curve. All minting and redemption operations are authorized by a 14-member Security Consortium running a Cosmos-based BFT appchain, with an independent second-check layer (Bascule Drawbridge, operated by Cubist) that must also sign before any mint or payout occurs. The protocol deploys a Proxy Upgrade Timelock on each chain for implementation upgrades and uses GnosisSafe multisigs for governance, pauser, and treasury roles. Vault strategies (BTCoc, BTCe, BTCu, BTCmm) are wrapped as ERC4626-compatible Veda vaults and deployed across Ethereum, Base, BSC, Sonic, Corn, and 10+ additional chains.
